data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 proposes a concrete candidate-network construction (a 44-comparator 13-input network by inserting 5 comparators into the optimal 12-input network) that predicts a directly measurable, machine-checkable outcome: does the resulting network sort all 8192 binary vectors? The problem explicitly requires that rival positions predicting whether a candidate sorts must file a typed sandboxed Python simulation; SRC_001's simulation_refs is empty, so the claim that a 5-comparator insertion yields a valid 44-comparator sorter is prose-only and unverified per the dossier's own standard. Additionally, the claims about S(12)=39 and the best-known 45-comparator bound are not grounded in any dossier block id citation.
